summary: Build practical anti-bribery controls, conflict-of-interest workflows, and investigation-ready reports. Enrol in practitioner-led training.
lede: Anti-bribery and conflict-of-interest training helps compliance, audit, procurement, HR, and governance professionals identify risks and document control decisions. It covers bribery risk assessment, third-party due diligence, gifts and hospitality approvals, and conflict disclosures. Participants build practical registers and checklists, review exceptions, and prepare investigation records and reporting dashboards for decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who approve spending, oversee people and partners, test controls, manage disclosures, or report integrity risks to leadership.
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to compliance, audit, procurement, HR, governance, finance, legal, or programme operations. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with internal policies, approval workflows, or investigation referrals will help, but the course introduces the ISO 37001, ISO 37301, ISO 37002, COSO, and IIA reference points used in the exercises. You should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software; Power BI use is demonstrated through provided materials and does not require a personal licence.
